<!--
Inputs of the globe-toss dashboard, read by _bayes-globe-engine.qmd.
Included by apps/bayes-globe.qmd and slides/week06.qmd.
Every input cell references `reset`, so a click on the reset button rebuilds them all at their defaults.
-->

```{ojs}
//| label: prior-inputs
//| echo: false
viewof reset = Inputs.button("Reset to defaults")

presets = ({
  "Uniform": { a: 1, b: 1 },
  "Weakly informative": { a: 2, b: 2 },
  "Informative": { a: 14, b: 6 },
  "Dogmatic": { a: 500, b: 500 }
})

viewof preset = (reset, Inputs.select(Object.keys(presets), {
  label: "Prior preset",
  value: "Uniform"
}))

// Rebuilt whenever the preset changes, so a preset resets both sliders.
viewof a = (reset, Inputs.range([0.5, 1000], {
  label: "α",
  value: presets[preset].a,
  step: 0.5,
  transform: Math.log
}))

viewof b = (reset, Inputs.range([0.5, 1000], {
  label: "β",
  value: presets[preset].b,
  step: 0.5,
  transform: Math.log
}))

viewof zeroOn = (reset, Inputs.toggle({ label: "Rule out θ below cutoff", value: false }))

viewof cutoff = (reset, Inputs.range([0.05, 0.95], {
  label: "Cutoff",
  value: 0.75,
  step: 0.01
}))
```

```{ojs}
//| label: data-inputs
//| echo: false
viewof trueTheta = (reset, Inputs.range([0, 1], {
  label: "True θ",
  value: 0.71,
  step: 0.01
}))

viewof nSim = (reset, Inputs.range([1, 1000], {
  label: "Tosses (N)",
  value: 15,
  step: 1,
  transform: Math.log
}))

viewof redraw = (reset, Inputs.button("New sequence"))
```
